name: Eastside Tenants United
purpose: Organizing support and a repair fund so tenants can fix urgent problems in 14 buildings.
about: A tenant-led association covering 1,100 homes on Marlow's east side.

name: Harrow Street Garden Collective
purpose: Turning two vacant lots into a shared garden with raised beds for older neighbors.
about: Neighbors who started gardening on one empty lot in 2019.

name: Upper Valley Youth Stage
purpose: After-school theater for teenagers in three small towns, with free transport.
about: A volunteer-run youth theater that now has paid staff.

name: Lowlands Mutual Aid Network
purpose: General operating support for the network's food pantry and emergency fund.
about: Started during the 2020 shutdowns; now feeds 600 families a month.

name: Coast Fishing Families Association
purpose: A community kitchen and a winter jobs board for fishing families.
about: An association of 180 fishing households in three harbors.

name: Marlow Mexican Cultural Center
purpose: Weekend folk art and music classes and the Día de Muertos festival.
about: A cultural center in a former bank on Fourth Street.

name: Pinecrest Seniors Circle
purpose: Rides, meals and a weekly social for isolated older people.
about: A circle of volunteers in the Pinecrest valley.

name: Alder River Keepers
purpose: Water quality monitoring by trained volunteers at 60 sites along the river.
about: The region's watershed council, founded in 1998.

name: Willow Marsh Restoration Project
purpose: Reconnecting 340 acres of marsh to the river to slow floodwater.
about: A partnership of farmers, the county and the Lowlands Conservancy.

name: Kestrel Creek Tribal Natural Resources
purpose: Restoring salmon passage on Kestrel Creek and training tribal youth as field technicians.
about: The natural resources department of the Kestrel Creek Tribe.

name: Small Systems Water Alliance
purpose: Helping 22 small rural water systems test, repair and plan for drought.
about: A technical assistance nonprofit for water systems serving under 3,000 people.

name: Estuary Commons
purpose: Community science on the estuary with three high schools.
about: A marine lab and education center at Port Alder.

name: Lowlands Flood Ready
purpose: Flood plans, warning systems and grab-and-go kits for 4,000 households.
about: A coalition formed after the 2024 flood.

name: Marlow Public Library Foundation
purpose: Book bundles and reading coaches for 900 families at six branches.
about: The fundraising partner of the Marlow Public Library.

name: Read Together Upper Valley
purpose: A home-visiting reading program for families with children under five.
about: A family literacy program run from the Pinecrest library.

name: Libros Para Todos
purpose: Bilingual story times and a free bookmobile in farmworker communities.
about: A bilingual literacy nonprofit with one very popular van.

name: Port Alder Elementary PTA
purpose: A summer reading club with free lunches and a book to keep each week.
about: The PTA of the only elementary school in Port Alder.

name: Third Grade Promise
purpose: Training 120 volunteer tutors and matching them with second- and third-graders.
about: A tutoring network active in 31 schools.

name: Alder Building Trades Pathway
purpose: A paid pre-apprenticeship for 80 people a year, with childcare and tools provided.
about: A partnership of four trade unions, Alder Community College and two community groups.

name: Second Shift Marlow
purpose: Paid training and job placement for people returning from prison.
about: A reentry program founded by formerly incarcerated people.

name: Coast Marine Trades Academy
purpose: Boat repair and marine electrical apprenticeships with five boatyards.
about: A training program at the Port Alder boatyards.

name: Valley Care Careers
purpose: Paid training for home care aides, with a guaranteed wage of $24 an hour.
about: A partnership of three home care agencies and the Upper Valley workforce board.

name: Lowlands Flood Relief Kitchen
purpose: Hot meals for families displaced by the March 2024 flood.
about: A church kitchen that cooked 9,000 meals in five weeks.

name: Harbor Mill Workers Fund
purpose: Emergency rent help for workers after the Harbor Mill closure.
about: A fund set up by the mill's former union local.

name: Upper Valley Fire Recovery Circle
purpose: Replacing tools and supplies for small farms after the Ridge Fire.
about: Farmers helping farmers after the August 2026 fire.

name: Marlow Night Shelter
purpose: Extra beds and staff during a week of extreme cold.
about: An emergency shelter run by volunteers since 2011.

name: Riverside Community Land Trust
purpose: Keeping 40 homes permanently affordable after the flood buyouts.
about: A land trust owned by its residents.

name: Coastline Youth Surf Club
purpose: Free surf and ocean safety lessons for 200 local children.
about: A club run by lifeguards and parents.

name: Upper Valley Headwaters Trust
purpose: Protecting 1,200 acres of headwater forest with willing landowners.
about: A land trust in the Alder headwaters.

name: Story Bus Lowlands
purpose: A second bookmobile and Saturday stops at the flood recovery centers.
about: A literacy project of the Lowlands library district.

name: Marlow Green Jobs Corps
purpose: Paid training in solar installation and home energy repair for young adults.
about: A youth corps working with the city and two installers.

name: Harbor Family Resource Center
purpose: A family resource center with a food shelf, legal clinic and parenting classes.
about: The only family resource center on the Coast.
